emails.subject: SaaS Weekly: pricing experiments, churn benchmarks and more
emails.body:
{{newsletter_early}}This week in SaaS Weekly:

1. Pricing experiments that worked. Three B2B companies share what happened when they moved from per-seat to usage-based pricing. The short version: expansion revenue went up, but forecasting got harder.

2. Churn benchmarks for 2026. Median logo churn for mid-market SaaS sits at 11% annually; best-in-class teams are under 6%.

3. Tooling roundup. A look at five onboarding analytics tools and where each one fits.

4. Hiring. Product operations roles are up 18% year over year.

Thanks for reading. You are receiving this because you subscribed at saas-weekly.example.{{newsletter_late}}
